summary: activities list --all follows meta.next_cursor through cursor and falls back to numeric pages only when no next_cursor key is returned; MCP activities.list pages through cursor via data.meta.next_cursor; a page-numbered sync never sends a body cursor as page=. A stored non-numeric checkpoint for a page-numbered sync restarts at page one; a discarded body token still advances the page-numbered walk on a short page; auto --all keeps write-through and local fallback. Round 20: one shared rule (normalizePageContinuation) for the flat and dependent sync loops: any non-empty page-type continuation proves a next page; only a non-numeric one is rewritten to the next page number. The stored-checkpoint guard lives in seedSyncPageCursor, which every flat and dependent request seeds through. Round 21: a numeric continuation proves more only when it advances past the page just fetched, and a per-walk set of visited pages (syncPageVisits, shared by both loops) ends a walk that asks for a page twice with an error. Round 22: the flat and dependent sticky-cursor detectors skip a page-numbered page that is a proven short end (syncPageIsProvenShortEnd), so a short last page repeating the previous numeric next completes normally.
reason: GET /activities (app/api/v1/activities/route.ts) answers {"data":{"data":[...],"meta":{page,per_page,total,total_capped,next_cursor}}}, takes a keyset cursor and a numeric page, and parses page as an integer, so a keyset string in page= is a 500 (Prisma skip NaN; 9 such 500s on the demo workspace on 2026-11-09). The generated --all and MCP page configs read a cursor at a path the response does not have (Greptile PR #2450 thread 4514458610, P1): --all found no top-level array and returned 0 rows; and the r17 page-numbered sync picked meta.next_cursor up by name and sent it as page=. Codex novel1219-r18: an r17 checkpoint resumed page=<keyset> until --full; the discarded token let a short page end the walk as complete; a short keyset page without next_cursor returned as complete; auto --all skipped write-through and network fallback.
validated_outcome: Fixtures use the live response shape. TestNovel1219ActivitiesListAllFollowsNextCursor (page one, then cursor=<next_cursor> with no page; three rows in order), TestNovel1219ActivitiesListAllFallsBackToPageNumbersWithoutNextCursor (no next_cursor key: page=2), TestNovel1219ActivitiesSyncWalksNumberedPagesPastAnOpaqueNextCursor (53 records, never page=<cursor>), TestNovel1219MCPActivitiesListFollowsNextCursor (an agent following cursor_param with data.meta.next_cursor reads both pages; page never carries a cursor). Live demo workspace: activities list --all --per-page 5 returns 345 of meta.total 345; sync --resources activities --full stores 345. Round 20 (red on d4132aa): TestNovel1219DependentFullPageWithOpaqueTokenAdvancesByNumber, TestNovel1219DependentShortPageWithOpaqueTokenAdvancesByNumber, TestNovel1219DependentShortPageWithNumericTokenAdvances, TestNovel1219SyncShortPageWithNumericTokenAdvances; TestNovel1219NormalizePageContinuation pins the rule.
